changelog.text: Added Watch Party support across Mobile, Android TV, and Desktop with live chat and synchronized playback.
Added real-time synced lyrics across all platforms with multiple lyrics providers.
Added stereo balance controls for a more personalized listening experience.
Added customizable fonts and improved Ringtone Cutter with waveform preview and audio fading.
Improved Watch Party synchronization, host switching, and connection stability.
Enhanced Android TV and Desktop interfaces with better navigation, layouts, and search performance.
Improved audio playback, shuffle navigation, repeat controls, and download reliability.
Fixed multiple security, privacy, playback, synchronization, and stability issues.
